runs.text: Read the length and the width of a rectangle and show its area. The program shows only the number.
The calculation goes in a subprogram
that receives the length and the width.

hints.text: Which data does the calculation need? Those are the parameters.
The subprogram returns the area; the main algorithm reads and shows.

runs.text: exists with two parameters. Frequent mistake: reading the data inside the subprogram, which then receives nothing.

assertions.name: RectangleArea
assertions.requirement: The calculation goes in a subprogram RectangleArea with two parameters.
